🎨 Design ×
Adjusts sizes & spacing on this screen only (remembered here). Find what you like, then 📋 Copy settings and send them to make it everyone's default.
📺 Wall tile sizes TV / wall mode only
Pick a bay or an Open Tasks by Assignee tile (page 1: Sal · Wrap · Electricians · page 2: Doug · Josh · Jeff), then size it for this monitor — width and height are independent (changing one tile never moves another). For bays, width sizes the whole column (Front + Back). Takes effect in 📺 Wall mode.

➕ Add a shop task

Writes a new row to the Shop Tasks sheet — it shows on the board within ~15 min.

➕ Add a shop job

Creates a brand-new job on the Input schedule — it appears on the board within ~15 min.

🔄 Bring back a trailer

Pick a shipped/finished trailer that's coming back (3–6 mo or annual maintenance). It returns to the Parking Lot (Active, starting today) with its open tasks intact — and the previous ship date is logged, so each visit stays in the trailer's history.

➕ Add leave

Saves to the Input schedule as a leave entry — it shows under Staff on Leave within ~15 min (and instantly on this screen).

✎ Edit job

Move it to another bay, change the dates, or tweak the notes. Saves to the Input sheet — board updates within ~15 min.
⚠ This job has its own task list, so the board shows those — text typed here will not appear as a task. To add one that shows (and can be assigned), use ➕ Add task below.

✎ Edit task

✎ Edit Project Tasks

Add, edit, complete, delete tasks and set predecessors — writes back to the workbook (board updates within ~15 min).

👥 Standardize Assignees

Merge variant spellings into ONE canonical name across all project tasks and shop-floor tasks — writes back to the workbook (board updates within ~15 min). Names that look like typos or aren't on the approved list are flagged ⚠.

⇄ Bulk Edits

Stop opening tasks one at a time. Pick a project, check the tasks, choose what to change below (assignee · phase · type · status), set the value and hit Apply — it changes every checked task at once. Stage several changes, then Save. (Assignee keeps the group and adds the person, e.g. MRA Design / Sarah Williams.)

👥 Manage Logins

Add a person, change someone's code, or remove a login. Codes are stored hashed — for security they're never shown, so to change one you just set a new code. Saves to the workbook (applies within ~15 min). Admin only. Real per-person sign-in + roles come in a later step.

📅 Manage Holidays

Add a company holiday — it shows as a soft shaded band on the day (hover shows the name + US/CA) on every schedule when you're zoomed in, so the team can plan around it. Informational only — it never blocks scheduling. Standard US & Canada holidays are always shown. Saves to the workbook (applies within ~15 min). Admin only.

Task

🧹 Ghost tasks

Leftover task rows whose floor job was deleted or finished long ago — they don't show on the board (and don't count as unassigned), but they're still sitting in the Lists. ✓ Close or 🗑 Delete them here to clean house (needs code).

📧 PM report

Everything on that PM's projects — health overview, done last 7 days (last 24h highlighted), coming due, milestones. Open it, then print or copy the link into an email.

⚠ Unassigned tasks

Every open task with no crew, grouped by job — plus 📋 project-schedule tasks assigned to “MRA Shop” (nobody has picked them up) that start or finish within the next 2 weeks or are overdue; further-out schedule lines stay hidden until their window. Tap the 👤 to assign one right here — 📋 ones write the crew back to the project schedule, and everything drops off once it has a crew.

🖨 Print / 🧾 Work Orders

The whole board, a crew task sheet, or a maintenance work order per job — tick one or more crews below.
🧾 Work Orders = one printable work order per job for the ticked crew(s), with the job's photos & docs enlarged and a signature line (Doug with 5 jobs → 5 work orders).

⬆ Upload Filled Intake Template

Pick your filled-in template (the ⬇ Download Intake Template file). It's read right here in your browser — review the tasks, then send them to the schedule. They show up on the next ~15-min cycle.

📋 How to add or update a project

Download → fill → load it back. No Excel skills needed — it shows on the board within ~15 minutes.
  1. ⬇ Download Intake Template and open it in Excel.
  2. Fill it in: type the Project and PM once in the boxes at the top — they auto-fill down every row. Add one row per task. The gold Milestone rows are ready gates: rename/date the ones you need and delete the rest.
  3. Load it back — pick any one:
    • ⬆ Upload Filled Template (right here) — choose the file, check the preview, hit Send to schedule.
    • Drop it in the shared Intake Inbox folder.
    • Or copy your task rows → Paste → Values into the master Project Tasks sheet (columns line up 1:1).
  4. Replace vs. add: name the project exactly the same as an existing one and the upload replaces that project (a clean merge); a new name adds a new project.
  5. That's it — give it ~15 minutes to appear for everyone.

A snapshot of every active project — %, health, next gate and overdue items. Copy it into an email or print to PDF.

📄 Build a Hard-Date Schedule

      
Pick a project, choose how much detail to include, and a style — it builds a print-ready schedule (opens in a new tab; Save as PDF there). Three levels: just milestones & hard dates, + Tasks (milestones & every parent task), or + All tasks & subtasks (everything, indented).
